name: VestraTube
author: zysilm
punchline: Search YouTube in the sidebar and play videos right away
description: A YouTube sidebar for Vestra Player: search, see thumbnails, titles, durations and channels, and play a video with a double-click. Download videos as MKV files, or play and download a single video from its link. No sign-in and nothing to install: the YouTube part uses the bundled open-source library youtubei.js, downloads use the player's own ffmpeg.
